description: Show the processes listening on a TCP port, or on every port

port.description: The port; every listening port when left out

name: port.who

address.description: The local address, such as 0.0.0.0, ::, 127.0.0.1 or ::1.

name.description: The owner's program name; null when the owner is hidden or ended meanwhile.

pid.description: null when the owner is hidden, as another user's process is on Linux and macOS without elevation.

output.description: What a program the command ran printed

truncated.description: Where the result was cut to fit, and how much
